title: OxonFair: A Flexible Toolkit for Algorithmic Fairness
benchmark_measurement: Bias in toxicity classification associated with religious groups.
base_benchmarks: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification
findings: On the Jigsaw dataset with religion as the protected attribute, the OxonFair toolkit consistently reduced the difference in equal opportunity (DEO) more than other tested debiasing methods. However, the paper also notes that debiasing methods, in general, were less effective at mitigating bias on the Jigsaw dataset compared to the Twitter dataset.
